items.headline: BEAMS and adidas made an actual loafer
items.caption: For BEAMS' 50th birthday, adidas built a tasselled loafer on chunky soles.
body: It's more formal shoe than sneaker.
There's a preppy black leather version with white Three Stripes.
How to wear it: with white socks and pleated trousers.

items.headline: Japan's FamilyMart now sells great T-shirts
items.caption: Its second collab with TRIPSTER brings long- and short-sleeve cotton tees.
body: FamilyMart has more than 14,000 stores.
TRIPSTER started as an architecture firm.
How to wear it: a boxy tee under an open overshirt.

items.headline: Jordan's new Strada is a skate shoe
items.caption: A casual Jordan with Nike Air and skate-shoe padding.
body: It looks a lot like Nike SB models.
But it's pure Jordan Brand.
How to wear it: with baggy jeans and a hoodie.

items.headline: JW Anderson's Christmas collection is peak whimsy
items.caption: Oversized argyle Pringle sweaters, stockings and quirky homeware.
body: Jonathan Anderson is fashion's Mr Whimsy.
It's British eccentricity, done well.
How to wear it: one loud knit, everything else plain.

items.headline: The 12 best-dressed stars at GQ's Men of the Year party
items.caption: Swaggy suits and bold colours at the Chateau Marmont.
body: Stavvy wore a chartreuse suit.
Guests took the 'modern red carpet' dress code seriously.
Style lesson: one bold colour beats five.

items.headline: A sashiko Air Jordan 1 for Japanese denim fans
items.caption: Social Status' Jordan 1 Low borrows Japanese stitching.
body: Made for people who know which mill made their jeans.
Social Status is a North Carolina boutique.
How to wear it: with raw selvedge, cuffed.

items.headline: Timothée Chalamet's surprisingly classic tux
items.caption: A grey Armani shawl-lapel tux, bow tie and dress shoes.
body: Most men are dressing baggy right now.
For Chalamet, playing it straight was the twist.
How to wear it: slim tux, clean shoes, no gimmicks.

items.headline: How to wear a suit in 2026, the Scandi way
items.caption: The founders of Saman Amel and Cavour share their rules.
body: Scandi tailors blend Italian and British styles.
Then they do their own thing.
How to wear it: soft shoulders, muted colours, easy fit.

items.headline: Tom Holland and Zendaya disagree on watches
items.caption: Holland wore a rose-gold Cartier Tank Louis at the Governors Awards.
body: He paired a Louis Vuitton dinner suit with tan Louboutin boots.
Zendaya made a different choice.
Style lesson: a classic dress watch never fails.

items.headline: Citizen's Star Wars watch has a working Death Star
items.caption: The Attesa Death Star II swaps the moonphase for the Empire's superweapon.
body: It turns with the lunar cycle.
'That's no moon,' indeed.
Style lesson: one fun watch is allowed.

items.headline: Inside the first Vacheron Constantin watch concours
items.caption: Vintage Vacheron pieces competed like classic cars.
body: Hodinkee reports from the first event of its kind.
It felt more celebration than contest.
Style lesson: vintage can outshine new.

items.headline: A new guide for vintage watch collectors
items.caption: Eric Wind and Charlie Dunne's book goes on sale November 17.
body: It aims to help beginners and long-time collectors.
Hodinkee says it goes beyond pretty pictures.
Style lesson: learn before you buy.

items.headline: Attic seeds grow into an ancient 'miracle' wheat
items.caption: An Italian farmer revived decades-old seeds he nearly forgot.
body: Claudio Grossi tossed them into manure out of curiosity.
They grew into an ancient grain.

items.headline: 'Forever chemicals' fall sharply in England's rivers
items.caption: Levels dropped 30% in water and 49% in fish.
body: Two banned PFAS compounds are fading.
A researcher called it 'brilliant to see'.

items.headline: Tokyo trials robot bins to fix its trash puzzle
items.caption: Solar compactors and trash-hauling robots are winning fans.
body: Japan has few public bins on purpose.
Tourists often struggle with that.

items.headline: Climbers carry an orphaned seal pup up a cliff
items.caption: On Greece's Kythira, they rescued an endangered pup in a backpack.
body: The pup was stranded alone on Kalamia Beach.
The species is critically endangered in Greece.
